Location comments: A small 4 acre farm tract from the early 1900's on the west edge of the Chagrin River. About 2 miles north of North Chagrin Reservation.
Tree comments: A large mass of tree split and landed on the house 2011. Unfortunately most of the tree fell, and the rest was cut down to the stump.
